justification: Six files changed, all heading, link and table-header text; standard because the file count is over the minor limit, not because of any logic change.

pre_impl.existing_data: none: the evidence page text is static in the components
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If a test or jump link still names the old heading, the suite fails visibly; no data is involved
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Every evidence page render uses the new text; no stored rows are affected

functions.name: AtAGlance
functions.input: the evidence data object passed in as props
functions.output: summary tiles and jump links with the new section 2 and Sources labels
functions.if_none: unchanged: the tile already renders 'No checks were returned' when there are zero checks

functions.name: CheckSection
functions.input: the evidence data object passed in as props
functions.if_none: unchanged: counts fall back to zero and the intro still renders

functions.name: ProofSection
functions.input: the evidence data object passed in as props
functions.output: Sources heading and the section 164 accordion with its table headers
functions.if_none: unchanged: an empty exclusions list renders an empty table body

break_it.scenario: A heading and its jump link drift apart
break_it.what_happens: The jump link names a section that no longer exists
break_it.how: evidence-sections.test.tsx:400-401 asserts both the hrefs and the link text

break_it.scenario: A table header is mislabelled so a quote appears under a source heading
break_it.what_happens: Users misread which column is the law's words and which is the map checked
break_it.how: ProofSection.tsx:34 headers are 'What the law says' for the quoted text and 'Checked against' for the source; found by the Sol cross-review

break_it.scenario: Old wording left behind in another file
break_it.what_happens: A reader sees 'Land the rules leave out' or 'The proof' in one place and the new text in another
break_it.how: grep over components, app/reports and __tests__ for the old strings returns no matches
break_it.repro: git grep -n "The proof\|rules leave out" -- frontend-nextjs/components frontend-nextjs/app/reports

falsifiable_check.fails_when: A heading, jump link or accordion title in the evidence page differs from the text the tests assert, or the old wording is rendered
falsifiable_check.observed_red: After renaming the section 164 accordion title and before updating its assertion, the same jest command printed 'Tests: 1 failed, 174 passed, 175 total' (evidence-statement-page.test.tsx); after the assertion was updated it printed 175 passed.
